variants.title: 织物桌旗融入台面
variants.detail: Paint ONE flat, thin muted petrol-teal woven table runner directly on the RIGHT THIRD of the foreground counter surface, x790-980 at1280 width. Its far edge begins at y434; it runs toward the viewer and extends down behind the dialogue panel beyond y700, so only its upper portion and any naturally uncovered slivers are visible. Add a pair of simple faded warm-beige woven border lines, subtle pixel fabric folds lying flat, and a low-contrast contact shadow at its edges. Nothing stacked or rolled. Perspective subtly widens toward the viewer. Most of the counter remains warm wood. Keep cloth below the character waist, not hung vertically off the distant counter lip. The dialogue box must occlude cloth; do not paint over UI.

variants.title: 旧皮革桌垫融入台面
variants.detail: Paint ONE broad FLAT wine-brown / muted oxblood leather serving mat into the counter surface, spanning x250-970 at1280width. Its distant edge begins y440, and it extends toward the viewer down behind the large dialogue overlay to y660. Show only the part naturally exposed above/around UI, exactly as if painted into the background. Subtle inset stitch border in desaturated ochre, worn soft corners and broad restrained pixel patina, not gritty photoreal texture. Thin flush leather rather than a thick raised object. Keep a strip of original wood between mat and far counter lip. No repeated embossed symbols, no extra props. Dark burgundy adds a calm muted patch to the bright wood; low contrast, no bright border glow.

variants.title: 木台面整体美化
variants.detail: No cloth, no mat and no objects. Refine the actual foreground wooden countertop into warm dark walnut, still brighter than the UI but less orange and less mirror-shiny than now. Paint coherent broad horizontal pixel wood grain, a few understated worn marks near the serving area, softened amber reflections, and one narrow aged brass/wood inlay strip embedded flush into the tabletop just in front of its distant lip at y438. The inlay is a restrained simple continuous thin line, not a raised rail or golden neon. Continue the same material behind dialogue panel. The goal is a beautiful cared-for used wooden bar, a little richer surface structure but visually quiet; keep existing room and UI unmodified.
